title: Cat's Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chihiro, heir to the old Japanese confectionery Tsurumaruya, is secretly in love with Katsumi, his childhood friend and the shop's over-protective manager, who wants to honor the previous owner's last wish by living as the manager (DMP blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). Their feelings stall when an important customer, Mr. Mori, asks Chihiro to come to Tokyo; the volume adds a linked story about Mori's nephew, who moves in with him and keeps a secret, plus other short pieces.
life_message: It suggests that love must find its place alongside duty to family tradition and the family business (to verify).

content.note: Romance between adult men (AniList Boys' Love; MangaUpdates Yaoi) with a drunken encounter; MangaUpdates also lists incest, uncle-nephew and stepsibling love labels, apparently in the linked story; detail unconfirmed (to verify). MangaDex rates it safe.
